dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregularly crenulated, high-contrast white perimeters defining semi-closed circular and elliptical shapes. These structures exhibit a sharp pixel gradient at the outer boundary, transitioning from high-luminance white to the dark dorsal base color.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Isolated clusters of small, high-luminance pixel groups distributed with low spatial density across the posterior-lateral region. These lack internal gradients and appear as solid-tone speckles distal to the larger annular structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest anterior-dorsal annuli form a non-equilateral triangle with an acute vertex oriented towards the cervical region. A secondary group of posterior blobs forms a loose, linear horizontal alignment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, shadowed longitudinal indentation with brightened margins is located at the posterior-ventral junction near the rear flipper. A prominent transverse crease or collar-like indentation is visible in the cervical region.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly interconnected, reticulated network of high-contrast filaments on the mid-dorsal surface, creating a continuous labyrinthine texture rather than discrete isolated units.
